static_traits.name: 王丹
static_traits.social_status: 有几位亲密朋友但not yet向其敞开心扉；退稿后因Low sense of self-worth而趋向Social withdrawal，Interpersonal relationships受到影响
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；既往without类似心理问题，也not yet接受过心理治疗/咨询
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性Good，能准确描述自动化思维与感受；愿意配合探索并尝试小步行动；情绪偏Anxiety与低落但可被引导，具一定自我Reflection能力

basic_info.main_problem: 因书稿被出版社退稿后出现强烈的without价值感与Self-doubt，认为自己not擅长写作并应当彻底放弃，伴随灾难化、过度概括、读心术与“非黑即白”式思维；每当想到写作或准备开始新项目时，便感到沮丧与瘫痪，逐渐回避写作并与朋友疏远。
basic_info.core_demands: 'The rejection of the manuscript severely affected my self-esteem and my passion for writing (which is crucial to my well-being)', I hope through counseling to cope with self-doubt, correct negative thinking, and restore writing motivation and confidence.
growth_experiences: 几个月前，王丹投入大量精力创作的书稿被出版社退稿。退稿当时压力很大，此后开始出现强烈的without价值感与Self-doubt。她逐渐形成“一个拒稿意味着永远not会成功”的信念，认为自己not擅长写作，应当放弃；每当想到写作或尝试开启新项目，都会涌现“反正还会被拒”的想法而陷入行动瘫痪。其间虽尝试寻找其他兴趣Displacement注意，但without价值感持续存在；对日常生活的兴趣与Decreased motivation，人际上因感到失败而主动与朋友保持距离，且not yet向朋友透露自己的感受与困扰。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/have not天赋
我注定not会成功（一个失败就证明我not行）

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果一次Being rejected，就说明我have not写作天赋、I am not good enough；Being rejected就等于失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 决定放弃写作，Displacement到其他爱好以避免再次受挫
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not行了，应该永远放弃写作

special_situations.event: 坐下来准备写作或一想到要开始新项目
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果再写，还是会Being rejected/被嘲笑；只有被出版社接受才算有价值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 拖延、回避写作任务，久坐not动但not启动写作
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 有什么意义？反正还会被退

special_situations.event: 朋友对她的作品给予积极反馈或称赞
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 他人的称赞not可靠，朋友只是出于礼貌在安慰我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate正面反馈，只抓住退稿等负面证据来证明自己not行
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是客套，not是真的喜欢

special_situations.event: 想象编辑/读者会如何评价她的作品
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人not喜欢，就证明I am worthless；外界评价决定我的价值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少展示作品与社交接触以避免被评判
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们大概会觉得我很可笑/很糟

core_conflict.wish: 渴望自己的创作被看见与认可，作为Writer被接纳与肯定
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected、被嘲笑与negate，引发羞耻与失价值感
defense_goal: 通过Withdrawal与保持距离来避免再度被negate的伤害
先行贬低自我、negate积极反馈以减少外界评价带来的not确定与Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: 失败且not值得被认可的创作者
object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻、negate与挑剔的他者（出版社/潜在读者）

object_relations.self_representation: 会给do not人添麻烦的负担者
object_relations.object_representation: 表面友好但not真诚、可能敷衍的朋友

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当朋友或咨询师给予积极反馈或鼓励时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者体验为对方not真诚、只是出于礼貌（将内在的Self-denialProjection到他人）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以怀疑与negate的语气回应，use“他们只是客套”的表述，淡化或回避吸收正面信息。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to pick up writing again, try small-step actions, or focus on positive evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 诉诸“退稿更真实、称赞not可靠”的解释来维持现有观念，减少情感暴露
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用冷静、理性化的语气陈述“为什么现在not写更合适/失败概率更大”，避免触及羞耻与脆弱感。

manifestations: 在写作前自问“有什么意义？”认为反正会Being rejected
After manuscript rejection, loses the sense of purpose and value for the creation she once loved
outcomes: 写作动机显著下降与行为瘫痪

manifestations: Keeping distance from friends because one feels oneself a failure
not愿向朋友倾诉以免“麻烦do not人”

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Interprets friends' praise as 'just being polite', finding it hard to accept positive feedback
预设编辑/读者会嘲笑或negate自己的作品

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, and instead does it to the self, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: not愿麻烦朋友、选择独自承受，因而减少求助与分享
Turning support needs that could have been expressed outward onto oneself instead, leading to isolation

positive_force: Has intrinsic passion and a sense of meaning for writing (enjoyment of self-expression and creation)
工作功能稳定（短单厨工作not yet明显受影响）
Has several close friends who can be contacted (potential social support)
朋友曾给予积极的写作反馈
具自我Reflection与学习动机，愿意尝试小步行动与认知重评
negative_force: Cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, mind reading, black-and-white are prominent
Overly relies on external validation (uses rejection to define self-worth)
Social withdrawal与回避求助，削弱支持系统
negate正向信息（难以吸收赞誉与正面证据）
对失败的预测导致拖延与回避写作

target_behavior.behavior: Writing initiation difficulty and avoidance (feels paralyzed before writing)
antecedent: 想到写作或坐下准备开始新项目
回想被出版社退稿的经历
target_behavior.core_reason: 对再次Being rejected与被嘲笑的灾难化Anticipation（过度概括、预测not yet来），由羞耻与Self-doubt驱动
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的结果与情绪（拒绝、Shame, anxiety）
target_behavior.consequence: 写作Decreased motivation、创作中断，对日常兴趣降低、Impaired self-esteem

antecedent: 感到without价值与失败感上涌时
想到“会麻烦do not人/他人会negate我”时
target_behavior.core_reason: Shame and fear of evaluation, accompanied by mind reading and personalization
target_behavior.function: 避免被评判和可能的negate，短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 人际支持减少，Loneliness加剧，负性情绪恶化

target_behavior.behavior: 以“永远放弃写作”的决断/自我陈述
antecedent: 在反复回想失败并进行非黑即白评估时
target_behavior.core_reason: 全或without思维与过度概括（一次失败即判定永久失败）
target_behavior.function: 通过“切断可能失败”的方式暂时降低Anxiety与not确定感
target_behavior.consequence: Loses important sense of meaning and pleasure; self-esteem declines further
